scopeLabel: Independent scoped audit: main pp.1–6; SI pp.1–5, 8, 11–12. Ensemble XRD endpoints only receive phase labels.

sourceAudit.scope: Main pp.1–6; SI pp.1–5, 8, 11–12; prior sampled deep audit plus accepted r3 correction.

conflictPairs.text: Main Figure 2 visual last snapshot labels 12.4 s while the caption says 12.1 s; both are kept in figure provenance.
Main p.2 calls CdSe cores typically 3.5 nm; SI p.2 estimates 3.4 nm for synthesized CdSe seeds from an excitonic transition. These are distinct descriptions, not an averaged size.

Main Fig. 1 final diffraction is Ag2Se/Ag2S, while main prose sometimes shortens single-dot OFF outcome to Ag2Se; preserve two-component product identity and separate direct ensemble XRD from optical single-dot inference.

SI Figure S8 calls the control pure methanol with no AgNO3, but its last caption sentence reports AgNO3 concentration/flow settings. Do not assign AgNO3 to the negative-control reagent without resolving the contradiction.
Main Figure 4 is a stochastic simulation, not observed atomistic structures or additional synthesized specimens.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
